paragraphs.zh: All binders normally usable in dressings come under consideration as adhesives. Examples of suitable binders include thermoplastic polymers such as poly-vinylpyrrolidone, polyvinyl acetate, polyvinyl alcohol and tylose and also polyacrylates, polymethacrylates, polybutenes, polyisobutenes, polystyrene, polyethylene amines, polyethylene amides, the aforesaid protective colloids, polyesters, polyether esters, polyanhydrides, polyester urethanes, polyester amides, thermoplastic polysaccharides, for example cellulose derivatives such as cellulose esters, cellulose ethers, cellulose ether esters, including methylcellulose, ethylcellulose, hydroxymethylcellulose, carboxymethylcellulose, hydroxypropyl cellulose and starch derivatives and modified starches, dextrins, maltodextrins, alginates and chitosans, and also fats, oils, proteins, including casein, gelatin and zein, gum Arabic and shellac. The adhesives are preferably plant-compatible, i.e. they exhibit no, or no significant, phytotoxic effects. The adhesives are preferably biodegradable. The adhesive is preferably selected such that it acts as a matrix for the active components of the formulation. The quantity of adhesive will normally not constitute more than 40 wt. % of the formulation and preferably lies in the range from 1 to 40 wt. % and in particular in the range from 5 to 30 wt. %, based on the total weight of the formulation.

paragraphs.zh: In addition to the adhesive, the formulation for seed treatment can also contain inert fillers. Examples of these are the aforesaid solid carriers, in particular finely divided inorganic materials such as clays, chalk, bentonite, kaolin, talc, perlite, mica, silica gel, diatomaceous earth, quartz powder and montmorillonite but also fine-particle organic materials such as wood flour, cereal flour, active charcoal and the like. The quantity of filler is preferably selected such that the total quantity of filler does not exceed 70 wt. %, based on the total weight of all non-volatile components of the formulation. Often, the quantity of filler lies in the range from 1 to 50 wt. %, based on the total weight of all non-volatile components of the formulation.

paragraphs.zh: A preferred embodiment of the invention relates to liquid formulations of the forms A or C. In addition to the solid active substance phase, these have at least one liquid phase, in which tembotrione is present in form A or C in the form of dispersed fine particles. Possible liquid phases are essentially water and those organic solvents in which the form A or form C is only slightly soluble, or insoluble, for example those wherein the solubility of the form A or form C at 25° C. and 1013 mbar is not more than 1 wt. %, in particular not more than 0.1 wt. %, and especially not more than 0.01 wt. %.
paragraphs.en: A preferred embodiment of the invention relates to liquid formulations of the forms A or C. paragraphs.zh: Such suspension concentrates contain tembotrione as form A or as form C in a finely divided particulate form, wherein the particles of the form A or C are present suspended in an aqueous phase. The size of the active substance particles, i.e. the size which 90 wt. % of the active substance particles do not exceed, here typically lies below 30 µm, in particular below 20 µm. Advantageously, in the SCs according to the invention, at least 40 wt. % and in particular at least 60 wt. % of the particles have diameters below 2 µm.

notes: Printed page 9 of the publication, image p12.png, the densest page in the document at about 7,600 characters of text layer. It sits in the middle of the formulation part of the description and carries the tail of the colorants paragraph numbered on p11, then paragraphs [0114] through [0125] complete except that [0125] breaks off mid-sentence at the foot of the right column. Thirteen paragraph entries in all: twelve numbered, one unnumbered continuation at the page top. Roughly 100 named substances, the bulk of them in three lists: about 31 dyes and pigments in the continuation paragraph, about 35 binders and adhesives in [0114], about 15 fillers in [0115], plus 5 plasticizers in [0116], about 10 solvents in [0118] and 9 buffer acids in [0124]. LANGUAGE. This patent is in English, so the zh field carries the English exactly as printed, as the shared brief directs, and the en field carries the identical text. No translation was performed and none was possible. The only normalisation applied to either field is the rejoining of words hyphenated across a line break, and the collapse of the printed line and column breaks to single-line running prose; zh and en are byte-identical for every paragraph, so they stay line-aligned for resolve_translations.py. No blank line appears inside any zh or en value. MARKERS. The page prints its paragraph numbers in square brackets, as [0114], [0115] and so on, verified at 6x on the image; the brackets are genuinely on the page and are not an artifact of the layer. They are recorded here as bare four-digit numbers, 0114 and so on, which is the marker convention set for this run so that all fifteen pages agree. This is the one place where the recorded value departs from the printed form, and it is flagged in every paragraph note as well as here. OCR CROSS-CHECK. Every number, unit, colour index designation, ratio and chemical name on the page was read off the image at 2x and the load-bearing ones again at 6x, with the text layer at /tmp/us2010/page12.txt used only as a cross-check. Where they disagree the image was taken. Confirmed layer errors on this page: the micron sign becomes "Lum" or "um" ([0119], three occurrences); "(=rheology modifiers)" loses its equals sign ([0121]); "of tembotrione" becomes "oftembotrione" ([0120]); "C.I. Solvent Red 1," becomes "Red 1." with a full stop; the printed space in "wt. %" is closed up to "wt.%" throughout; and the layer capitalises words mid-sentence that the page prints lower case, at least solid, solvent, suspension, substance, surface-active, succinic, zein, and it prints SCs as "SCS". No digit on this page was found to be misread as a letter, but no digit was trusted from the layer either. The colon-numbers of the pigments and the ratio 10:1 to 1:10 were checked individually because a colon read as a full stop would change them. SOURCE ODDITY, NOT A TRANSCRIPTION ERROR. The colorants list prints "Basic Red 10" twice in succession, "... Basic Red 10, Basic Red 10 and Basic Red 108 ...", split across a line break in the source. Both occurrences are on the page and both are recorded. Per the no-silent-resolution rule the duplicate has not been removed. HEADER AND FOOTER. The running head is the publication number at the left and the publication date at the right on one line. The page number 9 is printed centred immediately BELOW that line, at the top of the page, not at the foot; there is no footer at the bottom of the page at all, and the bottom fifth of the sheet is blank white. The number is recorded in the footer field, where downstream consumers expect the page number, and its true position is stated here so the record is not misleading. NO TABLE. The tables of this patent are in the examples further on. There is no table on p12, so nothing had to be carried inside a paragraph as markdown here. CONFIDENCE. high. The scan is clean, the type is well resolved at 1707x2200, nothing on the page is illegible and the illegible array is empty. The residual risks are the two judgement calls stated above, the bare-versus-bracketed marker convention and the line-break hyphen in "plant-compatible" in [0114], neither of which is a legibility problem. PROVENANCE. This vision read was produced by Claude Opus 5 (claude-opus-5[1m]) reading the rendered page image p12.png, with the OCR text layer as a cross-check only.
marker_normalisation_note: Markers in this file were normalised to bracketed form by the run owner after the V pass. The page prints them as [0114] in bold and this agent verified that at magnification, but the shared briefing wrongly told every page agent they were bare four-digit numbers. That instruction was read off the OCR text layer, which strips the brackets and sometimes turns a closing bracket into a full stop, and which the same briefing tells agents not to trust. The agent recorded the contradiction rather than resolving it silently, which is why it was caught. Brackets are required downstream: make_visual_evidence.py:90 defines MARKER = ^\[\d{4}\]$ and filters printed markers through it, so a bare marker matches nothing and the page's whole marker placement is discarded without an error, and verify.py's PARAGRAPH_MARKER is ^(?:\[\d{4}\]|None\s). The reference run uses [0001]. Only the marker strings changed; no transcription, table, number or note was touched, and no marker was added to any zh field.
